latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Freebeat AI — Sync Videos to Music Beats:

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files (up to 500MB), describe your edit, and automatically sync video cuts to music beats in the cloud.
- Designed for TikTok creators; 1080p MP4 output delivered in 30–60 seconds.
- Seamless authentication using NEMO_TOKEN (automatic token retrieval for first-time users).
- Straightforward command mapping: export, credits, status, upload, and edit via chat or file drop.
- Exports and edits managed through a secure cloud session; includes error handling for common issues (file type, size, credits).
- Supports preview, export, and iterative edit workflows, with clear attribution and feedback throughout.
